method: Project each available dated NOAA weekly trajectory contour onto the OSW map. A coast-masked state contains it if the state covers every visible contour piece; otherwise an overlapping contour intersects it.
claim_limit: These are the NOAA weekly trajectories matched to 1 June daily eddies. Trajectories beginning later in the week are outside this join. Local IDs are not NASA ECCO eddies or named historical rings, and no relation implies passage outside the reported dates.
